observation: the two pad words are the other way round from the description: +0x0C is the newly pressed word and +0x14 the held word (as player_input_read fills them). A frame was let through (return 1, 5 calls, call 90) only when +0x0C had 0x8000, START newly pressed. The rest fits: call 43, with START and bit 0 both newly pressed, set bit 4 (0x43 to 0x53) and returned 1; pad 1 with nothing pressed left bit 2 set and returned 0; in item_test_all call 183 resumed (returned 1, flags back at 0x43 in call 184); 1,052 calls, all from pause_pads_poll
correction: (pad record from player_input_get: +0x0C newly pressed bits, +0x14 held bits): the frame pause driven by one pad, on pause_flags: when bit 0 is clear returns 0; not paused (bit 4 clear): pressing START (0x8000) while bit 0 is held sets bit 4 (paused); paused: pressing bit 0 while START is held clears bits 4 and 2 (resume), pressing START with bit 6 set clears bit 2 (lets one frame run), otherwise sets bit 2 (frame held); returns 1 when it paused, resumed or let a frame run, else 0; only caller pause_pads_poll
